summary: The bank sounds like DUMMIES. The Luxury lines are polished and superior, the Corporate lines speak in forms and logs, and the tier-free lines are calm, with no shouts, no player mentions and no invented consequences. One district line promises features that a screen in its district doesn't always have.

issues.found: Business district. Towers, barriers, a hit.
issues.rule: Lore follows state: a line may only say what the state guarantees. Generated screens can be an open street with no barrier run (LOG#P3-update-districts-puddles-big-battery-o3-33-o3-37) and towers stand on only 50% of large lots (EDIT41#7.2), so a CBD screen doesn't always have towers or barriers.
